title: Personalised CRM campaign with communication rules
measures: time-zone ambiguity blocks only the cases it affects

story.summary: Marketing manager sends a personalised campaign message
story.description:
As a marketing manager I want campaign messages to address each recipient personally while respecting communication preferences and responsible-gaming rules.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A campaign message can contain the placeholders {first_name} and {bonus_amount}, which are replaced with the recipient's values when the message is sent.
- If a recipient has no first name, {first_name} is replaced with "Player".
- Recipients who opted out of marketing communication are excluded from the campaign audience.
- Recipients with an active self-exclusion are never sent promotional messages.
- A recipient receives at most one message from the same campaign per calendar day.
